tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: Who The Very Lab is: legal entity, address, contacts, working hours, response time, markets served.

tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: What The Very Lab manufactures: product categories, service models (white label, private label, contract manufacturing), minimum order quantity, who it is and is not a fit for, and where to read more.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Full-text search over the public pages and blog articles of theverylab.com. Returns titles, URLs and short excerpts.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Returns the text (Markdown) of one public page or blog article of theverylab.com. Useful pages: /manufacturing/, /services/, /faq/, /about-us/, /contact-us/.

tools.name: how_to_inquire
tools.description: How a brand can contact The Very Lab about manufacturing, what to include, and the rules an AI agent must follow. This server cannot send inquiries.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_site · Private data: get_company_profile, list_capabilities, get_page, how_to_inquire · Public sink: how_to_inquire.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_site · Private data: get_company_profile, list_capabilities, get_page, how_to_inquire · Public sink: how_to_inquire

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
